registers.label: Spare
lines: They carried the child into the temple.
And the old man took him in his arms.
My eyes have seen your salvation.
A light for revelation to the nations.
How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord.
Even the sparrow finds a home.
Come, let us worship the light of the world.
Our eyes have seen your salvation. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Two faithful old people have spent their long lives in this temple, waiting, and today a young couple comes through the gate carrying a baby.
Our eyes have seen your salvation.
Simeon takes the child in his arms, and the waiting of a lifetime breaks open into song: now let your servant go in peace.
Our eyes have seen your salvation.
For here is the light the prophets promised, a light for the nations and the glory of God's people.
Our eyes have seen your salvation.
How lovely is this house where even the sparrow finds a nest; come in, and hold the light.
Our eyes have seen your salvation. Thanks be to God!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: They bring the child into the temple courts.
Our eyes have seen your salvation.
Old Simeon takes him up and sings for joy.
Our eyes have seen your salvation.
Here is a light for revelation to the nations.
Our eyes have seen your salvation.
Come, let us worship the light of the world.
Our eyes have seen your salvation. Thanks be to God!
